Then check THIS PROMPT against its repo block: write the prompt you were given — verbatim and whole — to a scratch file OUTSIDE the clone (`mktemp`), then run `node scripts/check-routine-prompt.js --routine=runner --prompt=<that file> --out=docs/audits/runner-prompt-drift.json`. Exit 1 is a FINDING, never a stop: `git add docs/audits/runner-prompt-drift.json` so step 6's one batched push carries it, and carry on with the cycle. Exit 0: commit that file only if it is already tracked (that clears last week's finding), otherwise delete it — never commit it on exit 0 when it is untracked. Exit 2: no file, and name the reason in your cycle row.
